input.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR FOR THE PERFORMANCE OF SUCH SERVICES.
input.rationale: The cap is nominally mutual and indirect damages are mutually excluded, but it fails the fallback on carve-outs: the only exception is "PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF", which is the Independent Contractor clause and carves out nothing (there is no indemnity in the Agreement), so confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence and wilful misconduct all sit inside the cap. The Contractor-side cap is also per-Statement-of-Work "fees paid", which can fall well below 12 months' fees on a task-by-task T&M engagement. Redline makes the cap the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, adds Excluded Claims, and confirms Company's payment obligations are not damages.

input.quote: 7. LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR.
input.rationale: The heading of Section 7 promises indemnification but the Agreement contains no indemnity, hold-harmless or defence obligation anywhere (the only occurrence of "indemnif" is in the heading). There is therefore no Vendor IP indemnity, which is walk-away territory; we have inserted the standard Contractor indemnity (IP, breach of law, data incidents, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with notice/control/cooperation mechanics and a narrow Company-side indemnity.
